hooks.name: Check dev prerequisites on session start
hooks.description: Prints Go, Node, and pnpm versions at session start to confirm the dev toolchain is available

action.command:
printf 'Welio development environment:
  Go: %s
  Node: %s
  pnpm: %s

Run "make doctor" for a full prerequisite check. Use "make dev" to start the API, worker, and web app.
' "$(go version 2>&1 || echo 'not found')" "$(node --version 2>&1 || echo 'not found')" "$(pnpm --version 2>&1 || echo 'not found')"
